svg.title: P4 easy: ten scorecard rows and two verified task checks
svg.desc: Luna · gpt-5.6-luna: 0 of 2 verified; Terra · gpt-5.6-terra: 0 of 2 verified; Sol · gpt-5.6-sol: 0 of 2 verified; Astra · gpt-6-astra: 2 of 2 verified; claude-opus-5-thinking-high: 2 of 2 verified; inherit: 2 of 2 verified; gpt-5.6-sol-medium: 1 of 2 verified; cursor-grok-4.6-high-fast: 1 of 2 verified; composer-2.5-fast: 0 of 2 verified; Jev Choice · five development runs: 0 of 2 verified. Jev's result occurred in each of five development runs with driver changes. The two checks are atom at target and neighbours preserved. An unverified check does not imply that a neighbour moved. All are P4 easy, seed 0, mode H development observations, not success rates or mode-A leaderboard results.
